paper_metadata.title: Quantum vs. Classical Machine Learning: A Benchmark Study for Financial Prediction

summary: This paper benchmarks simulated QML models for finance across three tasks: directional classification with QNNs vs ANNs, live trading with QLSTM vs LSTM, and volatility forecasting with QSVR vs SVR/GARCH. Key reported numbers include QNN gains on AAPL (+3.8 AUC, +3.4 accuracy) and KCHOL (+4.9 AUC, +3.6 accuracy) in the 64-D directional task, QLSTM improving Sharpe in 2 of 4 regimes, and QSVR achieving its best volatility result on KCHOL with QLIKE -6.4352 (10-qubit angle encoding) but still not surpassing the best classical RBF SVR overall.

algorithm.ansatz: variational quantum circuit blocks per gate
algorithm.convergence_criteria: early stopping when ES AUC fails to improve for 30 epochs; final model selected by AUC and threshold calibrated to maximize Sharpe

problem_formulation.constraints_handling: threshold-based signal generation with no-trade region; transaction costs applied on position changes
